description: An oil-painted still life in dark brown tones. A brass compound microscope stands on the left, with a lit candle behind it at centre. On the right an open notebook shows a pen-and-ink drawing of a dividing cell, with dark threadlike bundles pulling toward two poles, and faint handwriting-like scribbles on the pages. A fountain pen rests across the page, with an inkwell and a glass dish in the foreground. Shelves and old books fill the dim background. The painting runs edge to edge with no frame.
